source_units.text: Explain a fictional tournament tiebreak using a worked example.
Aim the wording at participants in the invented Marble Circuit.
I want a neutral and explanatory tone.
The full text must be between 55 and 85 words.
Include the following invented details: The Marble Circuit breaks equal point totals by fewest retries.
Mira and Sol each have twelve points; Mira used one retry and Sol used three.
Preserve these exact phrases: "Marble Circuit", "fewest retries", "Mira ranks first".
